reviews.author: Hanna Plummer
reviews.text: Austin and Josiah have been nothing short of amazing! I thought my home would never get fixed because everywhere was too expensive, but then I found these guys! They are so nice, great prices, and professional! I can’t wait to start enjoying sitting outside again! 😊

reviews.author: Hannah Blick
reviews.text: Langham construction is a great company to work with. The guys are very professional and proud in their work and it shows. Would definitely recommend them!

reviews.text: Langham was on time , great communication and very thorough in there work .. my house siding looks amazing.. best place in town for sure !!

reviews.author: Luke James
reviews.text: Langham Construction has the best prices with the most professional staff. They communicated with me through the whole process and provided a clear and transparent vision. If you’re sick of dealing with con men, I highly suggest reaching out to Langham Construction!
